Uses model budget and complete recorded evidence without changing the run verdict. Supply rubric.instructions, optional structured
criteria, or null for objective-only grading. Continue with the unchanged rubric and returned cursor, sourceHash and reservationI
d. Completed page retries return cached…\n- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an
-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and r
esponds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` f
or progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…\n- [Get run status](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/
get-run-status.md): Run status, result, and summary. Poll until `status` is terminal (`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `timed
_out`). `grading` is not terminal (every trial has finished and the run is held for its gating judge, with `result` still `pending
`), so keep polling.\n- [Get a run's decision summary](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-decision-summary
.md): The canonical, versioned run decision contract: the verdict and where it came from, the counts with the population they coun

failed stage, the failure category, evidence s…\n- [Compare a run against a baseline](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-r
uns/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md): Compare this run against a baseline run: per-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_cas
e`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer pass-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, and whether the evaluation conf
ig changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare against the nearest earlier **completed**…\n- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency.
Cursor-paginated.\n- [Get an iteration trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iteration-trace.md): Full tra
ce envelope for one iteration: conversation messages, expected-vs-actual tool call analysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may
evolve. Treat it as an open document. Returns `404` with `details.reason: \"TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished wit
hout a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteration's step results](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iterations-step-r
esults.md): One row per authored test step, in order, with `status` (`ok`/`fail`/`skipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `eviden
ce` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls). The fastest way to see which step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a mi
ssing trace is not a `404`: step verdicts still retu…\n- [Cancel a run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-r
un.md): Request cancellation of an in-flight run; marks the run and its pending/running iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `gra
ding` for its gating judge CAN be cancelled: it lands `cancelled` with no verdict, which is the honest outcome for a run nobody wa
ited out. A no-op success when the run is alread…\n- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-run
s/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would
execute, before anything spends. The platform selects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and ski
pped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` count trials; `selectedCase…\n- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-failed-cases.md): Replay a finished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that di
d not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and passed (cancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform sel
ects the cases. See the rerun preview. The new run records `rerunOfRunId` and `rerunScope`, and becau…\n- [List a suite's runs](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n- [List a suite's pe
r-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized

iscovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's

se, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://doc
